product_title: Pink Ganesh Mantra Resin Pooja Thali (8 inches)
product_description: Add elegance to your rituals with this beautifully designed pink pooja thali, featuring a sacred Ganesh mantra, golden floral accents, and three brass diya holders. Perfect for daily pooja, Diwali celebrations, and festive gifting.
product_care_suggestion: Clean gently with a soft, dry cloth.
Avoid water and harsh chemicals on the decorated surface.
Clean the brass holders separately after use.
Store in the provided box in a dry place.
